title: lupinus lyallii subsp. washoensis
intro: Lupinus lyallii subsp. washoensis, commonly known as the Wasco lupine, is a plant species native to the western United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus lyallii subsp. washoensis include modulating immune responses and exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
